H7800.def: the same as «07799»; Shushan, a place in Persia:--Shushan.

H7801.def: (Aramaic) of foreign origin; a Shushankite (collectively) or inhabitants of some unknown place in Assyrian:--Susanchites.

H7802.def: or (plural of former) Showshanniym aEduwth {sho-shan-neem' ay-dooth'}; from «07799» and «05715»; lily (or trumpet) of assemblage; Shushan-Eduth or Shoshannim-Eduth, the title of a popular song:--Shoshannim-Eduth, Shushan-eduth.

H7803.et: probably from (07582) and the same as (08520)
H7803.def: probably from «07582» and the same as «08520»; crash of breakage; Shuthelach, the name of two Israelites:--Shuthelah.

H7804.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05800»; to leave, i.e. (causatively) free:--deliver.

H7805.def: a primitive root; to tan (by sun-burning); figuratively (as if by a piercing ray) to scan:--look up, see.

H7806.def: a primitive root; to twist (a thread of straw):--twine.

H7809.def: a primitive root; to donate, i.e. bribe:--hire, give a reward.

H7810.def: from «07809»; a donation (venal or redemptive):--bribe(-ry), gift, present, reward.

H7811.def: a primitive root; to swim; causatively, to inundate:--(make to) swim.

H7812.def: a primitive root; to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God):--bow (self) down, crouch, fall down (flat), humbly beseech, do (make) obeisance, do reverence, make to stoop, worship.

H7813.def: from «07811»; a pond (for swimming):--to swim in.

H7814.def: or schoq {sekh-oke'}; from «07832»; laughter (in merriment or defiance):--derision, laughter(-ed to scorn, -ing), mocked, sport.

H7817.def: a primitive root; to sink or depress (reflexive or causative):--bend, bow (down), bring (cast) down, couch, humble self, be (bring) low, stoop.

H7818.def: a primitive root; to tread out, i.e. squeeze (grapes):--press.

H7819.def: a primitive root; to slaughter (in sacrifice or massacre):--kill, offer, shoot out, slay, slaughter.

H7820.et: a primitive root [identical with (07819) through the idea of striking]
H7820.def: a primitive root (identical with «07819» through the idea of striking); to hammer out:--beat.

H7822.et: from an unused root probably meaning to burn
H7822.def: from an unused root probably meaning to burn; inflammation, i.e. an ulcer; --boil, botch.

H7823.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to sprout
H7823.def: or cachiysh {saw-kheesh'}; from an unused root apparently meaning to sprout; after-growth:--(that) which springeth of the same.

H7824.def: from the same as «07828»; a board (as chipped thin):--cieled with.

H7825.def: from «07812»; a pit-fall (literally or figuratively):--destruction, pit.

H7826.et: from an unused root probably meaning to roar
H7826.def: from an unused root probably meaning to roar; a lion (from his characteristic roar):--(fierce) lion.

H7827.et: apparently from the same as (07826) through some obscure idea, perhaps that of peeling off by concussion of sound
H7827.def: apparently from the same as «07826» through some obscure idea, perhaps that of peeling off by concussion of sound; a scale or shell, i.e. the aromatic mussel.:--onycha.

H7828.et: from an unused root meaning to peel, i.e. emaciate
H7828.def: from an unused root meaning to peel, i.e. emaciate; the gull (as thin):--cuckoo.

H7830.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to strut
H7830.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to strut; haughtiness (as evinced by the attitude):--X lion, pride.

H7831.def: from the same as «07830»; proudly; Shachatsom, a place in Palestine:--Shahazimah (from the margin).

H7832.def: a primitive root; to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play:--deride, have in derision, laugh, make merry, mock(-er), play, rejoice, (laugh to) scorn, be in (make) sport.

H7833.def: a primitive root; to comminate (by trituration or attrition):--beat, wear.

H7834.def: from «07833»; a powder (as beaten small): by analogy, a thin vapor; by extension, the firmament:--cloud, small dust, heaven, sky.

H7835.et: a primitive root [identical with (07836) through the idea of the duskiness of early dawn]
H7835.def: a primitive root (identical with «07836» through the idea of the duskiness of early dawn); to be dim or dark (in color):--be black.

H7836.def: a primitive root; properly, to dawn, i.e. (figuratively) be (up) early at any task (with the implication of earnestness); by extension, to search for (with painstaking):--(do something) betimes, enquire early, rise (seek) betimes, seek diligently) early, in the morning).

H7837.def: from «07836»; dawn (literal, figurative or adverbial):--day(-spring), early, light, morning, whence riseth.

H7838.def: or shachowr {shaw-khore'}; from «07835»; properly, dusky, but also (absol.) jetty:--black.

H7841.def: from «07836» and «03050»; Jah has sought; Shecharjah, an Israelite:--Shehariah.

H7842.def: dual of «07837»; double dawn; Shacharajim, an Israelite:--Shaharaim.

H7843.def: a primitive root; to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively):--batter, cast off, corrupt(-er, thing), destroy(-er, -uction), lose, mar, perish, spill, spoiler, × utterly, waste(-r).

H7845.def: from «07743»; a pit (especially as a trap); figuratively, destruction:--corruption, destruction, ditch, grave, pit.

H7846.def: or cet {sayt}; from «07750»; a departure from right, i.e. sin:--revolter, that turn aside.

H7847.def: a primitive root; to deviate from duty:--decline, go aside, turn.

H7848.et: meaning the sticks of wood [from the same as (07850)]
H7848.def: feminine of a derivative (only in the plural shittiym {shit-teem'}; meaning the sticks of wood) from the same as «07850»; the acacia (from its scourging thorns):--shittah, shittim. See also «01029».

H7849.def: a primitive root; to expand:--all abroad, enlarge, spread, stretch out.

H7850.et: act part of an otherwise unused root meaning (properly, to pierce
H7850.def: active participle of an otherwise unused root meaning (properly, to pierce; but only as a denominative from «07752») to flog; a goad:--scourge.

H7851.et: the same as the pl. of (07848)
H7851.def: the same as the plural of «07848»; acacia trees; Shittim, a place East of the Jordan:--Shittim.

H7852.def: a primitive root; properly, to lurk for, i.e. persecute:--hate, oppose self against.

H7853.def: a primitive root; to attack, (figuratively) accuse:--(be an) adversary, resist.

H7854.def: from «07853»; an opponent; especially (with the article prefixed) Satan, the arch-enemy of good:--adversary, Satan, withstand.

H7856.def: the same as «07855»; Sitnah, the name of a well in Pal:--Sitnah.

H7857.def: a primitive root; to gush; by implication, to inundate, cleanse; by analogy, to gallop, conquer:--drown, (over-)flow(- whelm, rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away).

H7858.def: or sheteph {shay'-tef}; from «07857»; a deluge (literally or figuratively):--flood, outrageous, overflowing.

H7860.et: act part of an otherwise unused root probably meaning to write
H7860.def: active participle of an otherwise unused root probably meaning to write; properly, a scribe, i.e. (by analogy or implication) an official superintendent or magistrate:--officer, overseer, ruler.

H7861.def: from the same as «07860»; magisterial; Shitrai, an Israelite:--Shitrai.

H7863.et: from the same as (07721) by permutation
H7863.def: from the same as «07721» by permutation; elevation:-- excellency.

H7864.def: for «07724»; Sheja, an Israelite:--Sheva (from the margin).

H7865.def: from «07863»; peak; Sion, the summit of Mt. Hermon:--Sion.

H7866.def: from the same as «07722»; ruin; Shijon, a place in Palestine --Shihon.

H7867.def: a primitive root; properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray:--(be) grayheaded.

H7870.def: by permutation from «07725»; a return (of property):--captivity.

H7872.def: feminine of «07869»; old age:--(be) gray (grey hoar,-y) hairs (head,-ed), old age.

H7873.def: from «07734»; a withdrawal (into a private place):--pursuing.

H7874.et: a primitive root probably meaning to boil up (compare (07736))
H7874.def: a primitive root probably meaning to boil up (compare «07736»); used only as denominative from «07875»; to plaster:--plaister.

H7875.def: from «07874»; lime (as boiling when slacked):--lime, plaister.

H7876.def: a primitive root; to keep in memory:--be unmindful. (Render Deuteronomy 32:18, "A Rock bore thee, thou must recollect; and (yet) thou hast forgotten," etc.)

H7877.def: of unknown derivation; Shiza, an Is.:--Shiza.

H7878.def: a primitive root; to ponder, i.e. (by implication) converse (with oneself, and hence, aloud) or (transitively) utter:-- commune, complain, declare, meditate, muse, pray, speak, talk (with).

H7879.def: from «07878»; a contemplation; by implication, an utterance:--babbling, communication, complaint, meditation, prayer, talk.

H7880.def: from «07878»; a shoot (as if uttered or put forth), i.e. (generally) shrubbery:--bush, plant, shrub.

H7881.def: feminine of «07879»; reflection; be extension, devotion:--meditation, prayer.

H7883.def: or Shichowr {shee-khore'}; or Shichor {shee-khore'}; probably from «07835»; dark, i.e. turbid; Shichor, a stream of Egypt:--Shihor, Sihor.

H7884.def: from the same as «07883» and «03835»; darkish whiteness; Shichor-Libnath, a stream of Palestine:--Shihor-libnath.

H7885.def: from «07751»; an oar; also (compare «07752») a scourge (figuratively):--oar, scourge.

H7886.def: from «07951»; tranquil; Shiloh, an epithet of the Messiah:--Shiloh.

H7887.def: or Shiloh {shee-lo'}; or Shiylow {shee-lo'}; or Shilow {shee-lo'}; from the same as «07886»; Shiloh, a place in Palestine:--Shiloh.

H7888.def: or Shiyloniy {shee-lo-nee'}; or Shiloniy {shee-lo-nee'}; from «07887»; a Shilonite or inhabitant of Shiloh:--Shilonite.

H7889.def: apparently for «03452»; desert; Shimon, an Israelite:--Shimon.

H7890.et: from an unused root meaning to urinate
H7890.def: from an unused root meaning to urinate; urine:--piss.

H7891.et: a primitive root [identical with (07788) through the idea of strolling minstrelsy]
H7891.def: or (the original form) shuwr (1 Sam. 18:6) {shoor}; a primitive root (identical with «07788» through the idea of strolling minstrelsy); to sing:--behold (by mistake for «07789»), sing(-er, -ing man, - ing woman).

H7892.def: or feminine shiyrah {shee-raw'}; from «07891»; a song; abstractly, singing:--musical(-ick), × sing(-er, -ing), song.

H7893.et: from an unused root meaning to bleach, i.e. whiten
H7893.def: from an unused root meaning to bleach, i.e. whiten; white, i.e. marble. See «08336».

H7894.def: from the same as «07893»; whiteness; Shisha, an Israelite:--Shisha.

H7895.def: or Shuwshaq {shoo-shak'}; of Egyptian derivation; Shishak, an Egyptian king:--Shishak.

H7896.def: a primitive root; to place (in a very wide application):--apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, × look, make, mark, put (on), + regard, set, shew, be stayed, × take.

H7898.def: from «07896»; scrub or trash, i.e. wild growth of weeds or briers (as if put on the field):--thorns.

H7899.def: from «05526» in the sense of «07753»; a brier (as of a hedge):--prick.
